brief: Create a publication-quality vector-like workflow infographic on white. Five unequal horizontal regions, all frame centres aligned, with only four short straight external arrows and empty connector corridors. The large Director region exposes its three real decisions through restrained mini constructions. Use readable black sans-serif text, thin dark contours, consistent modest corners, complete reference spacing and limited flat source-derived colour. No title bands or excessive blue outlines. The page title/subtitle stay in a white top margin. Every other word, symbol and icon belongs inside its frame. The final warning belongs inside the output frame. Do not print route prose, component ids or planning metadata.

colour_decision.rationale: Use the complete FiLM cool family only for evidence artifacts and warm family only for the Director decisions. White corridors separate the families. Compilation and output remain largely white with black type; pale marks suggest a generated figure without reproducing case outputs.
colour_decision.adjacency_review: Within each local semantic mini-construction the pale interior and slightly deeper boundary are neighbours; warm Director emphasis is separated from blue evidence by a broad white corridor. Do not colour whole cards or title backgrounds.
colour_decision.whitespace_plan: Keep most of the canvas white; all outer frames white, roughly 28px inner padding. Compact support regions and a larger decision region. Use generous internal spacing and short readable labels rather than filling every area.

topology_review: This is an orchestration workflow with an exact five-stage overview chain, not a learned model or independently running agent team. Method input supplies current scientific truth. SVG evidence contains selected constructions, settled narrative, graph and separate palette observations. Director combines these rather than copying source topology. Its three ordered decisions are colour/whitespace, frames/routes and exact content; topology review and inventory support this pass. Compile validates artifacts and produces a compact packet. One image call is followed by actual pixel inspection and recorded deviations. No automatic repair loop or editable reconstruction belongs here.
